tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi cho ga gsal bar byed pa bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi cho ga gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan bcu drug phyed phyed rtsa rlung thig le rnam par dag /bden don bcu gnyis ldan cing rnam pa nyi shu'i byang chub 'dzin// skad cig mngon par byang chub ye shes sku yi mthar son pa// thams cad mkhyen pa dang po'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan gtsug gtor la sogs drag po bdud kyi dregs pa 'joms/ bkra shis sna tshogs yum bcas lha mo rnams kyis glu dbyangs len// rgyal ba sems dpa' rnams kyi 'od zer du ma lang long gis// byang chub snying po rab mchog dbang bskur myur du rdzogs gyur cig /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur bar byed pa la lnga ste/ gang gis bskur ba'i slob dpon/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma/ gang du bskur ba'i gnas dang dus/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni rgyud nas yang dag pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa// dang por slob dpon kyang ni dam tshig can la rdo rje'i theg par gnas par yang dag rten par bya// de nyid bsgom zhing 'dod pa chung la dri ma rnams bral bzod dang tshul khrims can ni lam la zhugs/ slob ma rnams la lam ster byed pa dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'joms shing de nyid kyis ni tshangs par spyod// bdud rnams kyis ni rdo rje dbyug pa de yang sa'i steng du rdo rje sems par rab tu grags/ zhes gsungs pas yang dag pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid de rnams dang ldan pa'am/ gzhan yang*/ de nyid bcu ni yongs shes pa/ gsum las dge slong mchog yin te/ 'bring ni dge tshul nyid du brjod/ khyim na gnas pa tha mar gsungs/ zhes rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pas yon tan dang ldan zhing snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ni bla ma yin te/ de las bzlog pa ni bla mar mi rung ste/

sa thob ma gtogs khyim pa ni// bla ma ru ni mi bya'o// khyim pa gtsug lag khang dkor spyod// gzhan gyi g.yog dang zhing las dang*// tshong dang dam chos 'tshong ba dang*// rmongs pa sa stengs rdor 'dzin min// zhes rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs shing*/ 'dir yang nga rgyal khro ba mngon du gyur zhing dam tshig rnam par bral la rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa med// slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don gnyis mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang sems nyams dbang ma bskur ba dang*// longs spyod la chags bag med pa dang tshig rtsub dang bcas dbang po'i don du 'dod pa la dga' ba// bla mas rdzogs pa'i byang chub don du dmyal ba bzhin du mkhas pas de ni spang bya kho na'o// zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa slob ma yang 'dir gsungs pa/ zab dang rgya che'i sems dpa' bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong dang tshul khrims yon tan can shes pa// thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus dang sems mi g.yo dang de nyid thob pa shin du sbed pa dang*// gdug pa can gyi grogs po spangs pa'i slob ma de nyid shin du mkhas pa'i bla mas gzung bar bya// shes rab dbang bskur la sogs phyir dang gzhan zhes bya dang yang ni bar ma bsod nams don du'o// zhes pas bla ma dang slob ma phan tshun nges par brtags te/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pas rgyud kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bas mchog dang thun mong 'grub par 'gyur gyi khe dang grags pa'i phyir mi bya'o// gsum pa gnas dang dus ni/ shis pa'i gnas yid du 'ong zhing rkyen med par dpyid zla 'bring po'i nya la sogs pa/ gza' dang skar ma sbyor ba byed pa bzang por ldan pa'i dus su bya ste/ drag po'i dus sbyor dang bsreg pa'i tshes rnams spang bar bya'o// bcu la gsol ba btab nas sa brtag ste/ bcu gcig pa sa chog bcu gnyis par lhag gnas/ bcu gsum par dang bcu bzhi par dkyil 'khor bri zhing*/ bco lnga par dbang sbyin/ bcu drug par dga' ston bya'o// bzhi pa ji ltar bskul ba'i tshul la gsum las/

dang por slob mas bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing*/ bla mas kyang yo byad 'tshogs sam zhes dris la sngags kyi bsrung bar bya'o// gnyis par bla mas spros bcas spros med kyi bsnyen pa'i rim pa bya'o// gsum par dbang sbyin te/ de la lnga ste/ sa slang zhing brtag pa dang*/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga dang*/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dngos dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni sngar sbyang ba byas pa yin pa'i gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang lha khang mchod rten khang bzang gi don du/ sa phyogs der gzhi'i bdag po la sa slang bar bya ste/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje'i skur bsgoms te/ grong gi bdag po la gtor ma cig byin gyis brlab cing sngags 'dis btang bar bya'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa phyogs che ge mo'i sa pa ri bā yā/ i dham̐/ bha ling*/ ghan dha/ pus pam̐/ dī pe/ a kṣa tam̐/ da ta ma hi/ sa pa ri bā ram̐/ shri ghri a gā tshtshan du/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ i dan bha li ghri na du/ kha dan du/ pi pa tu sa pa ri bā ra/ sarba sa twa ni/ shan tyaṃ/ pus tyam̐/ rakṣa bha ra nam̐/ gur pa ti/ ka ro tu/ i dam̐ ba sa nam̐/ tyag tyad tha dzye/ man dha la bhu ma tiṣtha na du hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra a dzña pa ya ti swa hā/ zhes gtor ma btang nas/ gnas kyi bdag po gshegs su gsol lo// de nas sa'i lha mo bskyed pa'i don du me tog cig bzhag nas/ bdag gi mdun du pad ma dang zla ba'i gdan la lam̐ las 'khor lo lam̐ gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas 'khor lo dbyug pa rdo rje/ g.yon du lcags sgrog dril bu can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed la sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab la/ nor 'dzin lha mo sangs rgyas yum// sems can thams cad phan mdzad ma// rdo rje sems dpa'i bka' yis ni// skad cig nyid la 'dir spyon cig

/oṃ lam̐ a hūm̐ ba su dha ri/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes spyan drang zhing gnyis su med par byas la/ oṃ laṃ a hūm̐ ba su dha ri pra bā ra sad ka ra argha pra ti tsa ye swa hā/ zhes mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du/ pa tyam̐ dang*/ a dza ma nam̐ dang*/ pro khya ma nam̐ rnams kyis chu bzhi phul la/ me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa gzhan yang phul nas bstod pa ni/ lha yi dbang po dang bcas pa'i// bdud sde rgyal bas bcom pa yi// dpang du lha mo khyod ni gyur// de phyir khyed ni mchod par bya// lha'i mchog gis phyag byas pa// bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes cig /ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// sku phyed thon te gser gyi mdog /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan// lha mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma// g.yas pa'i phyag na 'khor lo dang*// dbyug pa rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// g.yon pa'i phyag na dung dang ni// lcags sgrog rdo rje'i dril bu bsnams// khyod ni sa 'dzin lha mo ste// sa 'og gtso mo khyod la 'dud/ ces bstod nas/ oṃ laṃ a hūm̐ bha su dha ri sarba bhud dha dzña na ni sarba swa twa u pa ka ri ni/ badzra swa tya a dzña pa ya ti shri ghram̐ a gad tshtsha a gad tshtsha/ i dham̐ ghan dham̐/ pus pam̐/ dhi pam̐/ ne pe te/ pha lā ā kṣa ta da ta mi/ dha bha dha me bha/ ghri na ghri na man dha la ar thā ma ma swa ta nam̐ da da sarba swa ta naṃ/ shan ting*/ pus ting*/ ti kri nā shu bha tsi ta ni/ i dam̐ sa na tyag tra/ a pa ra sa ni gha tshtsha gha tshtsha swa hā/ zhes brjod nas gshegs su gsol te/ gzhan yang spros pa la dga' na/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ mdo la sogs pa klag par bya'o// de nas sa brtag ste/ sto 'phye brtags nas brkos la/ sa dkar dri bzang po ska ba dang kha ba'i ro can ni bram ze'i rigs te zhi ba dang rgyas pa la bsngags so// dmar po pad ma'i dri can ro tsha bas ni rgyal rigs te dbang dang dgug pa la'o// ser po lan tsha'i dri can da ra bo ni rje'u yi rigs te rings pa dang rmongs pa la'o// nag po brnag gi dri can lan tshwa dang skyur ba ni/

rmangs rigs te bsad pa dang bskrad pa la'o// ro dang dri thams cad dang ldan pa'i ljang khu ni las thams cad la'o// gang du rwa dang rus pa dang sol ba ni mi dge ste/ nor bu la sogs pa byung na shis pa'i mtshan mar 'gyur ro// gang du las dang mthun pa'i sar ma gyur na sbyang pa ni de tshe dho'am chu la thug gi bar du brkos te las dang mthun pa'i sas bkang la dri dang ro'i don du/ dkar po la a ru ra dang tsan dan dkar po/ dmar po la pad ma dang*/ tsan dan dmar po/ tsha ba gsum mo// ser po la khyar rnams dang bu ram mo// nag po la sha rul gyi chu dang*/ lan tshwa dang skyur ba bsre bar bya'o// ljang khu la thams cad bsre'o// rdzas kyi sbyang ba'i phyir zhi rgyas dang rims gsal ba la shel dung mu tig gzhug go /dbang la ghi ham̐/ dgug pa la mtshal/ 'khrug pa la ldong ros/ rengs pa la ba bla/ rmongs pa la sbrul/ bskrad pa la bya rog gi sgro/ zhe sdang ba la bong bu'i rus pa/ phur bus gdab pa la ma he'i rus pa gzhug go /gzhan yang zhi rgyas dang las thams cad la rin po che rnams gzhug go /de nas stegs bu dbus mtho zhing shar dang byang bzhol ba khru gang nas khru stong gi bar du legs par bya'o/ lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga la dgu ste/ sbyin bsreg lhag par gnas pa/ sa'i lha mo lhag gnas/ dkyil 'khor lhag gnas bum pa dang*/ thig skud dang*/ rdul tshon dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// 'dir las so so la 'dug stangs/ bgrang phreng*/ me tog spos/ lha bshos/ byug pa/ mar me/ gos/ chag tshad/ 'khrul 'khor/ gnas/ mtshan ma/ phur bu/ bum pa/ dus tshod/ yams shing*/ phyogs/ rdul tshon/ dgod pa/ mchod yon gyi snod/ dgang blugs/ lha'i sku mdog kha lta lugs/ bsam pa/ sngags kyi mtha' bsgyur te/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams 'dir yi ges 'jigs pas 'grel par shes par bya'o// dang po sbyin bsreg lhag gnas kyang*/

cho ga gzhan du bstan pa bzhin du bya'o// de nas sa lhag gnas la gsum ste/ byin gyis brlab pa/ bsrung ba byas nas nga rgyal bskyed cing gar bya ba/ lha mo lhag gnas so// thog mar gnas nye bar brgyan cing*/ dag pa'i lci bas dkyil 'khor byugs nas/ dris brlan pa'i lag pas nye ba'i snying po brjod cing dkyil 'khor la reg nas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bdag dang gnas dang slob ma bsrung ste/ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rus pa'i rgyan dang bcas te 'dug nas/ bsrung 'khor rdzogs par bsgom zhing*/ 'byung po dang*/ bsrung ba'i lha thams cad la gtor ma byin la/ bgegs la phur bus gdab cing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom mo// las kyi rdo rjes phyogs bzhi nas mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pa phul la bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya ba ni// shar nas de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol/ de bzhin du lho nas mchod pa dang bstod pa'i rjes su/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun du bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// yang byang nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan nyid min pa thams cad spangs// kun du bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsal// yang nub nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bstan du gsol// zhes bskul nas/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis bgegs la bka' bsgo ba'i don du rdo rje dril bu dang spos thogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsol ba gdab ste/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs gang sangs rgyas rnyog pa rnam par bral dang byang chub sems dpa' yum dang bcas// de rnams mchog gi thugs rje yis ni dkyil 'khor dbang bskur don du bdag ni nges par bskyang bar mdzod// ces brjod nas dal zhing g.yo ba'i gar gyis dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su langs la rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgyas rkang pa la reg la/

hūm̐ las rdo rjer bsgyur te/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag byas shing*// hūm̐ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas// khro bo'i rgyal po bcom ldan rdo rje shugs// dpa' bo'i rgyal po brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// stangs stabs du mar ston la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis lhag rgyal ba'i phyag na mtshon cha'i tshogs// bgegs tshogs ma lus pa la bsdigs par mdzad// nyi zla 'bar ba lta bu'i sdang mig gis// bgegs dpung bsreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /gang 'dir bde gshegs pho brang 'bri ba yis// bgegs kyi rigs tshogs gang yin byer bar gyis// gal te bka' las 'das te mi 'gro na// rdo rje 'bar ba la sogs mtshon cha yis// mgo bo 'gas par byed par gdon mi za// de bas bka' las ma 'da' myur du song*// zhes bskul nas byang shar du phyin la/ gang su dag lha dang lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang 'byung po srin po dang yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ rjed byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ grin non dang rgan po dang*/ rgan mo dang g.yog dang 'khor dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang*/ rigs sngags grub pa khyed rnams dengs shig sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon che ge mo zhes bya bas/ sems can thams cad kyis bla na med pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa rdzogs par bya ba'i don du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o// de'i phyir rdo rje 'chang chen po'i bka' 'di thos nas myur du dengs shig gang dag mi 'gro ba de'i mgo /bdag rdo rje shugs kyi rab tu 'bar ba gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba'i ye shes kyi rdo rje chen po 'dis rnam pa brgyar bkas par bya'o// lus ngag yid gsum la gnas pa'i// bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// bka' yi 'khor lo sbyar ba'o// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gzugs kyis ni// lus gsum las byung 'gas byas te// gal te kha cig bdag las 'da'// 'dir ni 'jig 'gyur gzhan du min// ces khro bo'i tshogs spros nas bgegs bcom la gar bya ste/

g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang mnyam pa yi// zhabs kyis bcags shing bskor ba yis// rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsal// yam̐ las ral gri zlum po'i stabs// ram̐ las rin chen g.yas g.yon brkyang*// sa ga'i stabs te lam 'khor lo// g.yas g.yon stangs stabs rdor dkyil dkrung*// bam̐ las pad ma'i phyag rgya yis// dkyil dkrung phyed pa'i stangs stabs bya// rdo rje rol pa mi'u thung*// bung ba bzhad 'gros rgya mtsho bskyod// ri bo 'degs bskyod ru sbal 'gros// phyi lta nang lta g.yas g.yon bskor// stangs stabs drug cu rtsa bzhi yis// khams gsum zil gyis mnan par bya// mig gnyis lag gnyis de bzhin bskur// rkang pa gzhogs su g.yas bskor du// phebs rdob sbyor bas dgyes par bya// slar yang g.yon du de bzhin no// de nas rgyug pa'i gar byas nas// de nas g.yo zhing gar bya'o// myur du pheb rdab de bzhin du// gar bcas 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ zhes rtsa ba'i rgyud las gsungs pa ltar gar byas na/ oṃ hra hra hra hra la sogs pa'i sngags kyang brjod do// de nas yang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le byas nas snga ma ltar sa'i lha mo bskyed la mchod pa dang bstod pa dang gtor ma byin nas gsol ba bya ba ni/ rgyal bas lha'i bdag po dang bcas bdud rnams bcom ste lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur pa ste/ de phyir lha mchog rnams kyis btud pa'i lha mo khyod mchod bzhes shig bzhes shig bdag gi mchod yon 'di// ji ltar rgyal bas kyang ni byang chub phyir ni bdud kyi sde'i stobs rnams rab tu bcom pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis kyang ni slob ma dbang bskur ba'i don du bdud rnams rab tu gzhom par bya// oṃ ā lam̐ hūm̐/ badzra bhu mi ti ྴྟ ma tsa la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra dha ra a dzña pa ya ti swa hā/ zhes brjod nas gnas de nyid du thim pas sa gzhi 'od 'bar bar bsam mo// gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha lhag par gnas pa ni/

dkyil 'khor dri yis byugs te thig gis lha'i gnas btsal la/ dri'i thig le dbus su gru bzhi gzhan zlum por bkod nas/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ ye shes dgug gzhug dang mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa gnas skabs dang sbyar nas byas la rdo rje dril bu dang spos 'dzin pas gsol ba gdab ste/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag brtan g.yo'i bdag po ni// bcom ldan dus kyi 'khor lo gtso// sna tshogs yum gyi mgul nas mkhyud// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la'ang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can dag 'di zhes pa// nang par dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te// kun gyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod nas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// bzhi pa bum pa lhag gnas ni// bum pa shel lam dngul las byas pa'am// sa yang rung ste rgya sor bcu drug dpang su sor nyi shu/ ske sor drug pa/ kha'i rgyar sor brgyad de cha gnyis ni bu ga mchu 'phyang ba ni sor gnyis pa la/ rgyal dang rnam rgyal la nyi zla sgra gcan gyi steng du rdo rje/ shar gyi gnyis ral gri lho rin chen/ nub 'khor lo/ byang pad ma bris pa'am/ kha rgyan la bkod pa yang rung ste/ bcu la phyogs kyi kha dog dang mthun pa'i kha rgyan mgul chings dang*/ re dmig las gsungs pa ltar bum sman dang*/ dri dang*/ nor bu rnams bsangs la legs par bcas te/ rgyal ba dang rnam rgyal dbus kyi cha/ gzhan phyogs 'tshams su bkod la chu dang bum sman dang bdud rtsi lnga yang blugs te/ shu n+ya ta'i sngags kyis bsangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ham̐ hām̐/ hi hī/ hri hrīḥ hu hū/ hli hlī las bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed la/ bam̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ hri las pad ma'i gdan la lha rnams bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs nas gzungs thag las 'od zer spro bsdu bya zhing kha rgyan gseb tu dung chos bzhag nas/

oṃ ham̐ hām̐ hiṃ hiṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hliṃ hliṃ/ badzra pad ma a mri ta ga ta shu bhi shud dha/ ra dha rma dha du swa bha bā na/ sarba dha rma dha du sa bha bān ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes thun gcig gi bar du bzlas la dri la sogs pas mchod nas/ oṃ badzra u ta ke hūm̐ gis dung chos kyi chu blugs te gos kyi bkab la bzhag go /de nas lnga pa thig skud lhag par gnas pa ni srad bu kha na ma tho ba med pa kha dog lnga pa'am drug pa gzhon nu mas bkal ba khru brgyad pa sbom phra the bo'i nas kyi tshad tsam ste ji ltar ran cing mdzes pa ye shes dang las kyi skud pa gnyis byas te/ oṃ am̐ iṃ roṃ um̐ līṃ/ badzra su tra sarba dha rma ga sa bha bā/ sarba dha rma na e ka ka ra sa bha bā ku ru ku ru swa hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas dri la sogs pas mchod nas shar du bzhag go /drug pa rdul tshon lhag par gnas pa la ni/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba yin na nor bu lnga dang*/ rgyal po phal pa la nor bu phal pa la kha dog lnga'am/ phal pa la 'bras bsgyur ba la sogs pa kha dog drug gam nyi shu rtsa lnga pa legs par byas la/ oṃ am̐ iṃ riṃ um̐ liṃ/ su bhi shu dha pan tsa skan dha sa bha bā/ pan tsa skan dha sum̐ bhi shud dhi dha rma ni ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod de nub tu bzhag go /bdun pa rdo rje lhag gnas kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje la/ oṃ hūm̐ kro ta badzra sarba swa twa ku ru na ad ma ka sarba dharma me ka pu ka sa bha bā sarba dha rma na badzra su kha sarba bha na ku ru ku ru swa hā/ zhes brjod la lhor bzhag go /brgyad pa dril bu lhag gnas ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dril bu la/ oṃ ho badzra ghan dhā sarba dha rme ka prad dzña dha ni sarba be sarba a ka ra sarba dharma ni sa bha bī na pra bo dha ya swa hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la byang du bzhag go /de bzhin du u rgyan ni byang du/ cod pan lho ru/

sor gdub shar du/ rus rgyan dang*/ po ti/ dung dang*/ mda' gzhu dang*/ me tog dang*/ mkho ba'i yo byad rnams ni nub bam gang bder bzhag go /mchod pa dang gtor ma yang ci 'byor pa bsham mo// las thams cad pa'i bum pa yang rgyud gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya bar sems so// dgu pa slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni sngon du bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma btang nas/ thog mar bsrung ba bya ste/ slob ma'i spyi bor ham̐ ljang khu/ dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/ snying khar hūm̐ nag po/ lte bar ho ser po/ gsang bar kṣam̐ sngon po bkod la ngag tu brjod nas dri'i thig le dgod do// gnyis pa sngar thob pa ma yin pa khyim pa'i rigs la dge bsnyen nam tha na yang bsnyen gnas bstan dgos par 'grel par he badzra'i lung gsungs te/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid// ces pas so// gsum pa theg chen gyi gzhir gyur pa/ smon 'jug sems bskyed thob dgos pas sngar ma thob na skabs 'dir bstan te/ 'dir ye shes kyi le'u yi tshigs su bcad pa drug bcu bdun par mi'i bdag po dag pa'i byams pa la sogs sems kyis sems can rnams la chags pa thob 'gyur bas// mi dge ba'i yon tan can gyi zhe sdang 'dod chags la sogs sems ni 'dor bar 'gyur// 'gro ba dang ni 'gro bar 'dod pa'i byang chub sems ni rnam pa kun du dag pa gnyis su 'gyur// thar par 'jug pa dman pa smon pa rnam par bral ba rnam pa thams cad du ni bdud kyi sems/ zhes byams pa la sogs pa'i rgyu las skyes pa/ nyon mongs spong ba'i las can smon 'jug gi ngo bo dbye ba gnyis kyi phye ba/ de la 'jug pa'i mi mthun phyogs ngos gzung dang bcas pa bstan pas nges par blang dgos so// cho ga rgyas bsdus la ni nges pa med do// bzhi pa rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom zhing 'od zer gyis sgrib pa dag par mos la yi ge brgya pa yang bsgrag par bya ste/

'di rnams dang por dbang gi zhu ba phul nas bya bar rung ngo*// cho ga'i rim pa dang po'o// lnga pa maṇḍal dbul ba ni/ gzhan nas bstan pa ltar gser la sogs pa'i tshom bu dang bcas pas phul la/ las thams cad pa'i chus khrus byas nas gos ngur smrig bgos pas phyag byas nas me tog dang bcas pa yis gsol ba gdab ste/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// bla ma la ni skyabs su mchi// byang chub ma thob bar du ni// rgyal ba rnams la skyabs su mchi// khyed kyi zhabs kyi chu skyes kyis// srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// de ring nyid nas dang ba yis// lus ngag yid gsum dag par bzhes// zhes gsol ba lan gsum mo// drug pa ni snying rje'i dbang sbyin te// slob dpon bdag lhar gnas pa'i zhal du slob ma rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas snying khar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing yum gyi khar phab ste/ slar rang rang gi gnas su bkod par bsams nas/ slob dpon gyi rjes su gzung ba/ theg chen 'dir ni bu tshur shog /khyod ni theg pa chen po'i rigs// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga 'di// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// dus gsum byon pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i mthu nyid kyis// ye shes mnyam med yang dag mnyes// mnyam med sngags kyi sbyor ba yis// shā kya seng ge sogs mchog gis// dpa' bo byang chub shing drung du// shin du mi zad bdud kyi sde// stobs chen bcom nas myang 'das thob// de phyir kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bus yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod la don yang cung zad bshad do// bdun pa dam tshig dang sdom pa dang po sbyin pa'i don du gsol ba gdab pa ni/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sna tshogs yum gyis mgul nas mkhyud/ dus kyi 'khor lo bde chen po// slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan par// dpa' bo chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la gsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la gsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la gsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas khas blang zhing rjes brjod byed du bcug ste/

dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming che ge zhes bgyi ba// dus 'di nas ni gzung nas kyang*// snying po byang chub mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa mchog ni bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ste// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sdom pa sangs rgyas rnal 'byor 'byung*// deng nas brtsams te bzung bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum du brjod du gzhug go /da ni sngar bshad pa'i sems bskyed pa sdom pa dang bcas pa thun mong du sbyin pa'i cho ga'o/ gal te phyis rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba byed na rigs lnga'i sdom pa sbyin dgos so// zhes bshad pas gsol ba gdab pa/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la stsal nas ni// mgon po 'khor lo lha dag gi /de nyid slob dpon phrin las dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa gsang mchog bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// ces gong gi gsol 'debs la mthud nas brjod de/ gong ma'i rjes su rdo rje chen po'i rigs bsdus la/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// de nyid kyis ni gzung bar bya// slob dpon dag kyang bzung par bgyi// rin chen chen po'i rigs mchog gi /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// padma chen po'i rigs dag pa// byang chub chen po 'byung pa la// phyi nang gsang pa'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor bzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs chen bsdus pa la// sdom pa thams cad yang dag ldan// mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bzhin// kun nas so sor bzung par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gi bskyed bgyis shing*// sdom pa ma lus gzung bgyis nas// ma sgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum mo// 'di nyid du'ang dbang gi le'u yi tshigs bcad brgya bcu rtsa drug par rigs lnga'i sdom bzung dang*// go gsum pa nas brtul zhugs nyi shu rtsa lnga gsungs pa don 'dra mod kyi 'og tu dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gror bshad do// brgyad pa slob ma la rigs kyi sa bon dgod te/

slob ma'i spyi bor u/ dpral bar haṃ/ mgrin par rī/ snying khar i/ lte bar li/ gsang bar ā rnams dkar sngo dmar nag ser ljang khu'i rang bzhin rgyal ba yab yum du ltas la dri'i thig le bya'o// dgu pa dngos grub kyi mtshan ma'i phyir so shing sbyin te/ a shad tha la sogs pa'i shing la sor bcu gnyis pa rtse me tog gis brgyan pa dris bsangs nas slob ma la byin te/ ba'i rnam lngas byugs pa'i maṇḍal gyi steng du kha byang du phyogs pas dor bar bya ste/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ho haṃ kṣa/ badzra dhan ta/ ka tra tsa tur bhi mo kṣa/ mu kha bā shud dha sa bha ba/ ka ya wāka tsi tta dzña na/ mu kha bhan dha ma la bhi sho dha ya swa hā/ zhes byin nas slob mas rtse mo sos nem tsam byas nas/ oṃ ā hūm̐ zhes dor ro// mtshan ma ni/ byang nub lho shar rim pa yis// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po 'grub// steng 'og mkha' spyod sa spyod 'gyur// 'di la bskyar ba'i cho ga med// ces bshad do// bcu pa skyor chu ni/ bam̐ las byung ba'i chu dri zhim po sbyar ba blud la/ oṃ shri bhi shud dho/ sarba dha rma pa pam̐ ni pa tsa yā ni syaiṃ sho dha ni/ sarba bī kal pā a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod de/ bcu gcig pa bsrung skud ni/ srad bu dmar po drug bsgril du byas pa/ oṃ hriṃ hriṃ hraiṃ hrum̐ hrām̐ hra phaṭa/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ho ham̐ kṣa ma la bā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa zhes bsngags nas/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi dpung pa g.yon dang g.yas la bcings nas/ oṃ bhudha me tri rakṣa rakṣa swā hā/ zhes so// bcu gnyis la ku sha sbyin pa ni/ stan gyi don du hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ sngas kyi don du dhis byin gyis brlabs pa byin nas/ rdo rje rnon po chen po yis// las rnams shes par bya ba'i phyir// ku sha'i dam tshig bzhes nas kyang*// dge dang mi dge bstan du gsol// oṃ baṃ badzra tikṣa bam̐ zhes so// bcu gsum pa chos bstan pa ni/

thams cad mkhyen pas 'jig rten du// u dum 'bar ba'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung ngam yang na mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed nus so// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sdig pa gang zhig sngon byas pa// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ba yis// de dag thams cad zad gyur nas// grags pa mtha' yas sngags tshul la// gnas par gyur pa smos ci dgos// skyob pas gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang mngon par 'thob par 'gyur// zhes brjod nas/ de'i don yang cung zad bshad do// bcu bzhi pa slob ma'i don du rdo rje sems dpa' bskul zhing*/ mal bting ste slob dpon gyis rmi lam brtag pa ni/ oṃ ā aṃ aḥ badzra swa twa mā hā su kha/ badzra ka la tsakra shyir sha syai/ a bhi mu kho sa bha bā su do ྴྟོ/ bha bā bha ro dho bha bā/ ka yā wāka tsi tta a tiṣṭha naṃ ku ru ku ru swa hā/ zhes brjod de/ mchod pa byed na skabs 'dir byas nas/ slob ma rnams btang ste/ slob dpon gyi mal bting pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ham̐ badzra ka ma la da la gha be sha badzra su kha ma ha ni traṃ ka ro mi dze ta ta tha ga te na bya tri ta/ ha haḥswā hā/ zhes brjod nas dkyil 'khor gyi lhor nyal la mtshan ma brtag go/ lha dang lha mos lung ston pa la sogs pa bzang zhing*/ bdud la sogs pa gnod pa byed pa'i mtshan ma slob dpon nam slob ma gang gis mthong yang ngan par gsungs so// bco lnga ba ltas ngan bzlog pa ni/ slob dpon gyis ltas ngan pa bsrung ba'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms nas/ gtor ma btang ste/ sbyang ba'i sngags gzhan gsungs pa/ oṃ phraiṃ badzra dha ki ni/ badzra dha re sha ri/ gha ga na sa bha bā/ sarba tar bya bhi sho dha ni sarba tar bya ni bhi sho tra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phraiṃ phaṭa zhes cho ga ni gzhan dang 'dra bas bgegs bsal la gang gi tshe mtshan ma bzang po'am/

yang na ci yang ma mthong na dbang bskur bar gsungs so// lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa dkyil 'khor bri zhing bsgrub pa la lnga ste/ thig dang tshon dgye ba phyag mtshan dgod pa bsgrub pa dang mchod pa'o// thig ni spros bcas spros med gnyis las/ dang po ni rtsa ba las/ khru bzhi sor phyed pa yis ni// dpal ldan dkyil 'khor gsum thig gdab// ces pa lus la khru bzhi/ khru re re la sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ sor dgu bcu go drug la/ sor phyed pa brgya dgu bcu go gnyis su 'gro yang*/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi rnam par dag pa dang sbyar nas gsungs te/ cha bcu drug gnyis kyis bgos pas sum cu so gnyis/ de yang bgos pas drug cu rtsa bzhi/ de la cha phran gyi thig gsum gyis bgos pas brgya dgu bcu go gnyis su 'gro yang*/ thig don med rnams dbyi bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pas lag len la mi bya'o// spros med zla ba'i cha dag pa zhes pas zla ba bcu drug ste/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ gru bzhi mnyam par byas pa'i sar// bcu drug go ni sa ru bya// sku'i dkyil 'khor dor nas ni// slar yang bcu drug cha ru bya// gsung bya de yang dor nas ni// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bya ba ni// slar yang bcu drug cha yin no// zhes zla phyed gsum dag pa gsungs pa 'di gdab par bya'o// mang du smos kyang ci zhig dgos// sor phyed sor cig sor gnyis kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi tshad rnams bstan// cha phran kyang ni de nyid yin/ yang smras pa/ dang drug phyed gdab phyi ma'ang gdab// gnyis pa cha bzhir gdab par bya// gsum pa bzhi pa dor byas nas// lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab// bdun brgyad rta babs lha rnams yul// phyi ma gnyis kyang de dang 'dra// khor yug thams cad sor phyed pa// bzhi bzhi kun la nyi shu bzhi// sa chu me rlung rdo rje 'od// snying po'i padma sor phyed bcu// sangs rgyas lha mo sor phyed gsum// rdo rje gdung la sor phyed gnyis// byang chub sems dpa' sor phyed gsum// dpangs chen gnyis la dpangs chung cig

/dbus la bskor bas nyis 'gyur te// sor phyed sum cu gnyis dang bzhi// rta babs rim gsum dang po ni// sor phyed drug ste gnyis pa bzhi// gsum pa phyed dang gsum du 'gyur// gnyis ni har mi gnyis bum pa// rings su 'og ma nyi shu bzhi// bcu drug cu gnyis rim ji bzhin// gdung dang ka ba re re ste// rgyan rnams kun dang bcas pa'o/ 'dir mdor bsdus tsam ste 'grel pas rgya cher bstan na mang pa ci zhig byed/ de la lag len ni dkyil 'khor gyi steng dris byugs nas/ thig skud dri la sogs pas mchod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ka yā wākā tsi ta ka bhya tyaḥ sarba karma e ka kā re na badzra swad to haṃ badzra ma me su tra ya me hūm̐ aḥphaṭa ces brkyang la nam mkhar ye shes kyi thig btab nas/ las kyi skud pa la/ dzdza dzdza dzdza dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥzhes drangs la/ oṃ badzra su tra e ka kā ra sa tu sye na dzā dzāḥsarba dha rma su tra yā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ kṣa phaṭa ces brjod nas slob dpon rkang pa g.yas pa la sbyar g.yon dkyil dkrung phyed pas thig gdab ste rtsa ba'i thig brgyad dang*/ phyogs kyi thig btab nas me rlung mtshams kyi re ga mi 'gong par/ gong du bshad pa ltar thig gdab bo// tshon bgyi ba ni/ dkyil 'khor lte ba'i phur pa hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bton nas/ phur khung tshon lngas bkang nas dril bu'i sgra dang bcas pas/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// rang nyid rgyal po rdo rje 'chang// de bzhin gshegs pas kun gyi gnas// nyes pa kun las rnam par grol// 'khor lo'i nang du yang dag gnas// zhes brjod la rdo rje khu tshur gyis// oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ badzra tsi tram̐ sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dbang ldan nas cung zad bkye'o// de nas kha dog ni/ dbus kyi padma ljang khu// shar nag lho dmar nub ser byang dkar/ bum pa dkar po rdo rje'i gdung sngo// ka ba nag dung la sogs pa bzhi phyogs mdog

lha snam du dkar po'i gdan gsum ka la'o// thugs kyi pan rag dkar dmar sngo ba/ gzhan gnyis ljang nag /dkar dmar ser ba'o/ 'dod yon dkar pha gu dmar ba la rin po ches spras pa/ dra phyed nag po/ ba ku li ser po rin chen can/ kra ma shi sha ni dkar po'am sna tshogs/ lha'i gdan padma rnams phyogs kyi dmar/ mtshams kyi dkar/ rta babs ni mdzes mtshon no// rta babs kyi ka ba ser po'am phyogs mdog kyang rung*/ phyi rol gyi gzhi sngo nag gam ljang khu'ang rung ste/ 'di ji ltar mdzes pa'i rgyan bri'o/ gzhan du ma bshad pa mi bya'o// sa ser po chu dkar/ me dmar/ rlung nag rdo rje'i gzhi sngo/ 'od zer sna tshogs so// rdo rje rwa gal te bri na phyogs kyi kha dog ste/ pad ma'i khor yug kyang bya'o// me rlung bar gyi dur khrod brgyad kyi 'khor lo yang phyogs mdog go /steng 'og gi 'khor lo gnyis kyang shar nub tu ljang khu dang sngon por bri'o// sku'i rta babs kyi shar gyi steng du/ 'khor lo dang ri dwags pho mo gnyis nag po/ lhor bum pa'i g.yas g.yon du dung dang pad ma dmar po/ nub kyi shing dang mi'am ci pho mo gnyis ser po/ byang du rnga bo che/ dbyug pa dang tho ba dkar po bya/ dbang ldan du sa la zla ba nya dang*/ bden bral du nyi ma bri'o// tshon mthug srab kyang rlung me chu dang sa rim pa bzhin/ mthug cing tshon phyi rol mthug par bya bar bshad do// sa bon dgod pa ni kho bos mngon rtogs su rgyas par byas pa bzhin dgod de/ phyag mtshan thugs kyi la dbus rdo rje/ lha mo brgyad phyag gi dang por 'dzin pa/ sangs rgyas rnams pad ma dkar po'i steng du nyi ma la shar du ral gri lhor rin chen/ nub 'khor lo/ byang padma phyogs mdog go /'tshams padma dmar por zla ba la/ mer ud pa la/ lho nub padma/ rlung du 'khor lo/ dbang ldan ud dpal phyogs mdog go /khyams kyi sems dpa' drug /pad dkar nyi ma la sems ma rnams padma dmar po zla ba la dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor du/
