oṃ e bam̐/ pad ma badzra tsi hno pra dzña pa yo man dha la a dhi pa dhi badzra mu khā dzña nam̐ am̐ ga /ma mā dan du ham̐ hām̐ haḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes de ltar gsol ba btab nas de'i rjes su dbang bdun gyi dbang bskur bar bdag nyid kyis mos pa byas nas cho ga'ang ci rigs brjod do// de nas dbang bdun thob pa'i nga rgyal bskyed de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sab ta a bhi she ka sab ta bhu mi lab to pram̐ ho haṃ/ zhes dbang bdun rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga'o// de nas sngags pas bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang gong ma rnams la sngags kyi tshig 'dis gsol ba gdab bo// oṃ oṃ prad dzña pa yo ka la sha a bhi sha kam̐ me da da tam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a pra dzño pa yo/ ghu hya a bhi she ka me da da taṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ pra dzño pa yāo badzra swa ta bhi sha mā ha ro prad dzña dzña na a bhi she ka me ta da taṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su 'chad bzhin pa'i cho gas bdag nyid dbang bskur bar bsgom par bya'o// de nas nga rgyal bskyed de/ oṃ oṃ badzra sa te na badzra ka la sha bī ke na yā a bhi she ke to/ badzra sa tam̐ pu kro a tsa la bhu me lab to haṃ/ oṃ āḥbadzra swa ta nam̐ ghu hya a bhi she ka to badzra swa twa yu bha ra dzāo na bā bhu me lab to haṃ/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra sa te na pra dzña dzña ne na a bhi she ka to/ dhi te yāe badzra dha ro haṃ/ dharma me bhu mi lab to haṃ zhes nga rgyal bskyed par bya'o// dbang gong ma gsum gyi cho ga'o// de nas yang gong ma'i gong ma bzhi pa'i dbang gi man ngag sngags 'dis gsol ba gdab par bya'o// oṃ ha pra dzño pa ya ad ma ko badzra pra ta/ ma ha mu tra dzña na a bhi she kam̐ me pra yad tshtsha oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho phaṭa/ de nas bdag nyid dri ma med par dbang bskur bar mos par bya'o// de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal bskyed de/ oṃ ho dha rma dha tu/ a kṣa ra/ tsa tur a bhi she ke na/ a bhi she ke to/

badzra swa ta ad ma nam̐ ham̐ḥ dhi ti yo dhu da sha bhu mai lab to/ badzra sa to ma harma pra ma kṣa ra tre lokya bi dza yā kā lā tsā kra bha gha bhan e bam̐ ka ra/ zhes gong ma'i yang gong ma'o/ de nas phyag rgya drug gi sngags kyi tshig ni/ oṃ ham̐ ha/ bha ma ha da kṣi ṇi karna yo badzra kun dha la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥ ka ṭu ka na the badzra me ka le badzra karna the ge hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a ā bā ma dha kṣi nā ka ra yor badzra ru tsa ko'u hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha ha/ bā ma dha kṣi na bhan dha yor badzra nu pu re hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ haṃ haṃ/ bam̐ pan tsa a ka ra ma ha shu n+ya sa bha bā mā hā badzra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si sarba a ke bha rma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ am̐ āḥ dha na shi sha ra badzra a dha tsan tra badzra pa ṭo/ u de hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a āḥ oṃ sarba swa ra e ka tri sa ra sa bha bā badzra yā dzāo ba pi ta kan de hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes phyag rgya drug dgod do// de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpar byas nas bden pa brjod de/ nam mkha' skye ba'i mtshan ma'i phyir// thog mar tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// dus kyi 'khor lo deng bdag bsgrubs// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag bsgrubs mdzod// nyes pa med pa rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// bcom ldan chags chen dga' ba che// de nyid du ni bdag bsgrubs mdzod// shin du rnam dag chos kyi mchog /gdon nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems par bdag bsgrubs mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang chen mchog gi phyag rgya yis// rdo rje chen po gsal ba las// rdo rje snyems par bdag bsgrubs mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab kyang yin// dam tshig mchog gi 'dod pa mchog

/bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa de yis mgon po khyod// 'dod pa bdag la yongs rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal cing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag 'byung*// de nyid de bzhin nyid nges 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis bsgrib med mthong bar shog /ces brjod par bya'o// skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor dang rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa rgyud thams cad nas gsungs shing*/ 'dir nan tan du bstan pas ci 'byor pa bya'o// slob dpon 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ de nas yol ba'i phyi rol du khrus byas shing*/ gser la sogs pa'i maṇḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis gdams pa bya ba ni/ 'di ltar dal 'byor dang ldan pa shin du dka' shing de bas kyang rdo rje theg pa mthong ba shin du dkon te/ 'di nyid nas/ 'khor ba dag tu gal te mi nyid du gyur kyang chos kyi blo ni rgya lam na// de nas dge ba'i dbang gis sangs rgyas la ni rjes su chags pas dang po'i theg pa la 'jug cing*/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa la ni 'ga' zhig blo ni bsgom pa la gnas shing*/ de las 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas mchog tu bde ba'i go 'phang la ni 'jug pa kye ma'o shin tu dga'/ zhes gsungs pas/ khyed rnams kyi lus longs spyod dang bcas pa 'bul zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje theg pa rmad du byung ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thob par bya'o snyam pas gsol ba gdab bo// de ring nyid nas 'khor ba'i drag shul rnams kyis 'jigs pas rgyal ba khyed kyi zhabs kyi ni// chu skyes kyis ni srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms pas lus dang ngag yid dang ba yis ni skyabs su mchi/

zhes lan gsum mo// de nas dam tshig dang brtul shugs sbyin te/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad ma dang*/ 'khor lo dang las kyi rigs rnam pa lnga'i sdom pa dang dam tshig 'di rnams yang dag par bsrung ba'i blos lad mo bya'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya bla ma yang ni spyi bos blang bar bya ba 'dod pa'i rdo rje la// rin po che la sbyin pa rnams ni sbyin bya 'khor lo la 'dir rgyal ba mchog gi dam tshig bskyang*// ral gri la ni gsal bar mchod pa bya zhing chu skyes rigs la sdom pa rnams ni bskyang bar bya// rgyal ba bskyed par byed pa'i rigs la sems can rnams la thar pa'i rgyur ni byang chub sems ni bskyed par bya// 'tshe ba brdzun dang gzhan gyi bud med nor 'phrog pa dang chang 'thung ba rnams de bzhin spang bya nyid// 'khor bar de bzhin chags pas rang gi dge ba 'joms par byed pa'i sdig pa lnga po 'di rnams so// gang zhig gang gi dus su byung ba sum cu mi'i bla ma de'i ming gis sbyin par bya// rgan po kha na ma tho ba'i bza' ba ngan tshig smra ba 'byung po dang ni lha min dbang po'i chos// ba glang byis pa bud med skyes pa sum cu mi yi bla ma lnga po rnams ni bsnun mi bya// grogs po rje bo dang ni lha dang mi yi bla ma dge 'dun yid gtad rnams la 'khu mi bya// dbang po rnams ni zhen par zhes bya sa yi bdag po brtul shugs rnams ni nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// bdag po'i bka' bstsal srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed pa 'di ni khyod kyis bskyang bar gyis// zhes lan gsum mam cig kyang rung ste// bslab pa'i gzhi lnga dang mi bya ba lnga dang*/ mi bsnun pa lnga dang*/ mi 'khu ba lnga dang*/ zhen pa spang ba lnga ste 'di rnams ni rdo rje'i theg par zhugs pa rnams kyi brtul shugs nyi shu rtsa lnga'o zhes bshad do// de nas gdong g.yogs las kyi kha dog dang mthun pa la sngags 'dis bcing ste/

oṃ dhu dha sha am̐ gha ni ro ta ka ri ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma rig pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bcu gnyis 'gog par gyis cig ces mig bkab nas/ oṃ a kham̐ bhi ra hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis khrid la dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum byas te/ phyogs bzhi nas/ oṃ na ma ti hūm̐/ oṃ na ma ni hūm̐/ oṃ na mo na ma hūm̐/ zhes phyag 'tshal du bcug nas gral la bkod de/ oṃ ā hūm̐ gis lan bdun sngags pa'i me tog gi phreng ba byin la/ oṃ yo ga tsi ta u pa ta yā mī zhes so// sta gon ltar skabs 'dir rigs drug bkod kyang rung ngo*// de nas dam bsgrag par bya ste/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ de ring khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlob par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la bstan par mi bya'o// dad pa dam tshig med pa rnams la yang ma yin no// deng khyed de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'dis// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// zhes bsgrags nas rdo rje snying khar bzung ste/ oṃ de ring dus kyi 'khor lo ni// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// de nas dam tshig gi chu byin te// 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung cig /oṃ pan tsa a mri ta u ta ka thaḥ zhes phan yon dang nyes dmigs bsgrags nas chu blud cing*/

de nas slob dpon gyis dam tshig bsgrag ste/ deng nas brtsams te/ khyod kyi dus kyi 'khor lo nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar gyur ta re/ zhes brjod do// de nas sngar bsgoms pa'i stobs dang ldan pas ye shes dbab par bya ste/ sngon du bzlas pa bye ba byas nas sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag byas na dran pa tsam gyis khro bo'i rgyal po 'bebs zhes gsungs te/ bu rnams 'dug stangs brgyad gang yang rung ba byas la/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gang la mos par dran du bcug cing*/ spyi bor haṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ snying khar hūm̐/ lte bar ho/ gsang bar kṣam̐/ sum mdor raṃ/ rkang 'thil du dzhāeṃ yam̐ dang bcas pa bsams nas/ dkyil 'khaur gyi lha rnam 'od zer du bsdus la sku gsung thugs ye shes rgyal ba khro bo byang chub sems dpa' gang la mos pa khyad par du bsdus nas sa bon rnams la thim pas lus 'od du gyur par bsgom du bcug la/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i spos bsreg cing*/ oṃ āḥr rā ra rā la lā la lā badzra a bhe sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ rol mo dang bcas pas ting nge 'dzin bya'o// babs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ khro bo'i rgyal pos byin gyis brlabs pas/ mtshon cha can gyi lag pas bdud kyi tshogs la bsdigs par byed/ ces pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs te/ sku babs pas sku'i bya ba byed do// gsung gis ngag gi dbang phyug go /thugs kyis mngon shes 'thob bo// ye shes kyis sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro// sas ri bo ltar 'gyur ro// chus bsil ba dang*/ mes bsreg pa dang*/ rlung gis skam zhing g.yo ba dang*/ nam mkhas mi snang ba dang*/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis mig la sogs pa dbang po dang yul shes pa ste/ bsgoms pa las 'gyur ro/

ring du 'phar na/ hūm̐ a badzra mu zhes brjod do// gal te smra bar 'dod na lce la aḥbasgoms nas smros shig ces brjod na thams cad ston par 'gyur ro// de nas spyi bor me tog la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo// de nas oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par byas nas/ snang ba la ci snang dris pas las so so bstan te/ zhi rgyas la dkar po// dbang dang dgug pa la dmar po// bskrad pa dang bsad pa la nag po// rmongs pa dang rengs pa ser po// gso ba ye shes sngo ljang ngo*// de nas gdong g.yogs pa'i slob mas me tog gi phreng ba bzung nas/ rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma byas la dor bar bya ba ni/ bla mas bden pa'i byin brlabs bya ba// yang dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma bzhug pa 'di// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa yi// bsod nams ci lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces brjod nas/ de nas slob mas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ku la sho dha ni swa hā zhes brjod la me tog bsgyur bar bya'o// gang la phog pa ltas nas me tog de/ oṃ pra ti ghri na trām̐ i mam̐ sa twaṃ ma hā bha la zhes spyi bor sbyin no// de nas mig dbye ste/ oṃ de ring dus kyi 'khor los ni// khyod kyi mig ni 'byed par mdzad// lha yi spyan ni chen po ldan// theg pa bzang po'i sgrib pa bsal// oṃ dhi bya ni tra ya naḥ ud gha tra ya swa hā/ zhes bsal bar bya'o/ de nas dkyil 'khor bstan te/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su// dkyil 'khor 'di de nyid la ltos// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// phyag rgya sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs// dngos grub kun ni phun sum tshogs// dam tshig mchog tu khyod 'gyur gyis// rdo rje pad ma rtse rol pa// gsang sngags rnams la bsgrub pa gyis// zhes brjod nas/

dkyil 'khor gyi don bshad pa rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun che// thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor yin// tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po yang*// rdo rje rwa ni bzhi po ste// dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi// phyogs kun gru bzhi mnyam par 'gyur// yan lag bcu gnyis dag pa ni// sgo ni bcu gnyis dag yin no// sa zhes bcu gnyis dag pa ni// rta babs rnams ni dge ba'o// 'phags pa'i lam ni yan lag brgyad// phyogs kyi dur khrod brgyad rnams so// stong nyid bcu drug ka ba'o// gzhal yas khang ni khams rnams so// sgo khyud rnam thar brgyad po dang*// gzugs rnams yon tan brgyad po yin// sgo 'gram phyogs kyang de bzhin no// yid ngag lus kyi dbye ba dang*// tshul khrims la sogs phung po la// tshon lnga rnam par dag pa ste// brtsig pa gsum ni theg gsum dang*// dad pa'i dbang po la sogs lnga// thugs gsung sku yi dkyil 'khor lo// ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs rnams ni// dkyil 'khor gsum gyi stegs bu'o// pha rol phyin bcu rdzogs pa ni// rin chen pha gu sna tshogs te// dra ba dra phyed ma 'dres pa'o// chos ni bco brgyad rnams yin te// ba ku li yi dbang rnams dang*// dge rnams kra ma shi sha'o// stong pa la sogs rnam thar yang*// dril bu la sogs sgras gang ba// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rgyal mtshan 'grigs// yo bzhi me long dag pa'o// byang chub yan lag rnga yab 'dzin// yan lag dgu ni me tog spras// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams kyis// zur rnams sna tshogs rdo rjes rgyan// sgo dang sgo khyud 'tshams rnams su// bden pa bzhi yi rin chen spras// mngon shes lnga yi khor yug ni// chen po lnga yis rtag tu bskor// rnam pa kun du rtogs pa ni// rdo rje ra bas bskor ba'o// khor yug ri mo cig legs pa// ye shes rdo rje'i 'od kyis spras// shes rab thabs kyis dbye ba yi// zla ba nyi ma rtag tu 'char// lus ngag yid gsum dag pa ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bum pa che// rnga yab byang chub shing dang ni// de bzhin nor bu la sogs spras// 'di ni dpal ldan dus 'khor gyi// dkyil 'khor chos dbyings rnam pa'o// zhes bshad la/

lha rnams kyang kho bos mngon rtogs su/ khyab dag dpa' bo dus 'khor lo// zhes bya ba la sogs pa rnam dag byas pa'am rgya cher yang rung ste/ 'di dang 'di'o zhes bstan no// slob mas kyang*/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// zhes brjod do// slob ma 'jug pa'o// gsum pa byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun ni/ de nas rigs dag par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas las kyi rdo rjes slob ma khrid nas/ byang phyogs su byon la/ der rdo rje slob dpon gyis dbang gnyis sbyin par bya ste/ thog mar gser la sogs pa'i maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab ste// byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// dbang mchog dam pa byin pa ltar// bdag kyang skyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// srid pa'i 'jigs pa 'phrog byed pa// srid pa'i skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur// phun sum 'tshogs pa kun gyi gnas// khyod kyi zhabs la skyabs su mchi// zad med 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las// bdag gi skyabs ni gzhan ma mchis// des na snying rje cher mdzad nas// de ring bdag la sku drin mdzod// ces brjod do// de nas dang po rdo rje slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la sogs pa'i yum lnga'i rang bzhin gyis slob ma'i khams lnga byin gyis brlab cing*/ bum pa'i chu rnam par rgyal ba'i dung chos su bsdus pas spyi bo la sogs pa'i skye ba'i gnas lngar gtug cing*/ ngag tu/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// gsang ba gsum gyi gnas las byung*// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ ā i rī ū lī pan tsa dha tu bhi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing khrus bya'o// de'i dus sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis rlob lha mo rnams glu len khro bos bgegs bskrad par mos shing rol mo bsgrag me tog gtor bkra shis brjod par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa dbu rgyan sngar sta gon du gnas pa de bzhin gshegs pa lngar bskyed cing*/

gnas lngar bskor nas mgo la bskon te/ oṃ ā ī rī u li pan tsa ta thā ga ta pa ri shud dha swa hā/ zhes sngar ltar tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ bkra shis brjod cing chu yang gtor ro// de ltar dbang gnyis kyis sbyang gzhi khams lnga dang phung po lnga/ byis pa btsas pa'i tshe chus 'khrud pa dang cod pan gtsug phud 'jog pa la sogs pa'i rtog pa sbyangs nas lus kyi dri ma dag cing phung po dang khams rnams rgyal bas yab yum bcur gyur pa'i skal pa can du byas nas/ 'bras bu sa rab tu dga' ba dang dri ma med pa thob par byed do// de nas g.yas bskor du lho phyogs su khrid la/ dar dpyangs dang dril bu'i dbang gnyis sbyin par bya ste/ gsum pa dar dpyangs kha dog lnga pa nus ma bcu'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs te bcings nas skye ba'i gnas lngar bum chu gtor zhing*/ dbang bskur ba ni rdo rje che la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ oṃ a ā am̐ aḥ ha hā ham̐ hāḥho phreṃ dha sa pa ra mi ta pa ri pa ro ni swā hāḥ zhes sbyin no// bzhi pa rdo rje dril bu'i dbang ni/ dril bu dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes kyi yi ge rnams slob ma la stom zhing spyir bor gtugs nas lag tu byin te/ dung chos kyi chu gtor zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ ho surya tsan tra bhi dha ka ya swā hā/ zhes bkra shis dang bcas pas bya'o// de ltar dbang gnyis kyis sbyang gzhi g.yas g.yon gyi rlung bcu dang*/ byis pa rna ba 'bugs pa dang*/ smra ba slob pa'i rtog pa/ sbyong byed nus ma bcu dang*/ rlung sbyangs nas a li ka li rnam par dag par sbyangs pas ngag gi dri ma dag nas 'bras bu sa 'od 'phro ba dang 'od byed pa thob cing ngag smra ba'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro// de nas g.yas bskor gyis shar du thugs dag par bya ba'i phyir brtul shugs dang ming gi dbang gnyis sbyin te/ lnga pa brtul shugs ni/

rdo rje sor gdub dang mgo bor me tog gi phreng ba bcings la/ skye mched kyi byang chub sems dpa' drug dang sems ma drug gzhugs cing sngar ltar skye ba'i gnas lngar chu gtor la/ oṃ a ā e āai ar ār o āo al al bi sha ye in tra ya dha ni swā hā zhes sbyin no// drug pa ming gi dbang ni/ me tog phreng ba dang*/ rkang gdub lag gdub la sogs pa'i rgyan la/ ye shes kyi khro bo yab yum rnams bskyed cing stims la/ sngar lha bskyed pa'i gnas lngar chu gtor zhing*/ oṃ ha hā ya yā ra rā wa wā la lā tsa tya bhra ma bhi ha ra bhi shud dha yā swa hā/ de ring ngas khyod lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// sarba ta thā ga ta sid dha sa ma yā bhur ba swa zhes brjod nas/ rigs gang la phog pa'i ming sbyin te/ dbus kyi ming ni/ ye shes rdo rje/ rdo rje bde chen/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhe sdang rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje/ shar gyi don yod rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje/ las kyi rdo rje/ rlung rdo rje/ reg bya rdo rje'o/ lhor/ rin chen rdo rje/ ser sna rdo rje/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rdo rje'o/ nub tu snang mdzad rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje/ sku'i rdo rje'o/ byang du/ dpag med rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ pad ma'i rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje'o/ bud med rnams la rim pas chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ sgra rdo rje ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje ma/ reg rdo rje ma/ rdo rje sgrol ma/ rdo rje gos dkar mo/ rdo rje spyan/ rdo rje dri dang*/ rdo rje ma ma ki rdo rje bde ma la sogs pa ste/ 'dir rgyas par ma byas so/ de ltar thugs rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang gnyis kyis/ sbyang gzhi dbang po dang yul gyi zhen pa dang*/

byis pa'i tshe spyod pa slob cing ming 'dogs pa'i bag chags sbyong byed dbang gnyis kyis sbyangs shing*/ dbang po dang yul sems dpa' dang sems ma dang*/ khro bor gsal ba yid kyi dri ma dag cing*/ sa sbyang dka' ba dang*/ mngon du gyur pa thob par byed pa'i skal ba can du byed do/ de nas ye shes dag par bya ba'i phyir nub tu bdun pa rjes su gnang ba'i dbang sbyin te/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi lha rnams slob ma la stim zhing*/ skye ba'i gnas lngar chu gtor la/ oṃ ham̐ kṣa dha rma tsa kra pra par dha ka yā swa hā/ oṃ ham̐ kṣa badzra khar khā/ badzra tsakra/ badzra pad ma/ badzra rad na/ pra pa ta khā yā swa hā/ zhes brjod la/ oṃ las byung ba'i dung*/ āḥ badzra ka sha hri/ ces lag tu sbyin no// a las byung ba'i po ti a zhes lag tu sbyin nas/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mtshungs pa ste// kun gyi mchog tu mnyam nyid gsal// des na bsams pa tsam gyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// kun du gsang bar byed bzhin pa// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten ma lus thams cad la// ji ltar 'dul ba'i chos rnams kyis// 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar gyis// shes rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu dang mtshungs par/ ngal med dmigs pa rnam bral bas/ sems can don ni de rigs gyis// zhes brjod/ gzhan yang ho las byung ba'i mda' gzhu byin nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi zhes so// slob mas kyang mnga' bdag gsung ba de ltar bgyi zhes brjod do// dbang 'di ni sbyang gzhi ye shes rang bzhin gyis gnas pa dang*/ lo bcu drug par thig le rdzogs pas 'jig rten pa rnams longs spyod kyi bdag por lung 'bogs pa'i rtogs pa sbyangs nas ye shes kyi khams rdzogs te ring du song ba'i sa thob pa'i skal pa can du byed pa'o// de ltar rdzogs nas dag pa'i chos bstan te gsungs pa/

nges par rdo rje can gyi rigs la srog gcod bya bar 'gyur te rdzun gyi tshig ni ral gri la// gzhan gyi bdag gir byas pa'i rin chen 'phrog dang gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa pad ma mchog gi rigs// chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang yul rnams ma lus shin tu brten par bya ba 'khor lo yi// gdol pa mo la sogs pa'i bud med ma lus mkha'i pad ma brnyas par mi bya gri gug gi /sems can don gyi rgyud ni nor dang lus su bcas pa khyod kyis bsrung bar mi bya sbyin par bya/ zhes gsungs te/ 'dir ltar sa bdun gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa de gzhan ngan 'gro la gzhol ba bzlog pa'i phyir bsad pa dang*/ theg pa mchog la gzhug pa'i phyir brdzun dang*/ ser sna las bzlog pa'i phyir nor 'phrog pa dang*/ shin du chags pas dud 'gror skye ba las bzlog pa'i phyir bud med 'phrog pa dang*/ chang dang sha lngas rdo rje'i lus bsgrub pa dang*/ rigs thams cad la bde ba chen po cig tu bsgoms nas don bya ba ni gzhan drang ba'i phyir yin no// 'di ltar dbang bdun thob nas rang gi don du ni/ srog ni rnam rtog dang rlung yin pas de gcod pa dang*/ sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag go zhes sems bskyed dang ma bral ba brdzun dang*/ nor ni thig le phyir 'pho ba phrogs te lus la brtan par byed pa dang*/ pa ra shri zhes/ bud med rnams la kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i bud med dang ma bral ba dang*/ chang ni lus la thig le'i bde ba btung ba dang*/ shwa ni dbang po lnga'i ye shes mngon shes lnga'i stobs za ba ste spyad pa dang*/ lus kyi rtsa khams reg pa ma yin pa'i bde ba la spyad pa ste/ de ltar khyed rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa drug gi dam tshig bsrung zhing bsgom par bya'o// 'dir ltar lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag cing ye shes kyi skal ba can du byas nas 'bras bu 'grub pa 'di nyid nas/

dbang bskur bdun gyi dbang bskur bas ni dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun rnams kyi dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// des na khyed rnams kyis rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi po 'di rnams kyis ma gos par bya ste/ 'dir gsungs pa/ byis pa rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams ni dang por cig pa dpal ldan bla ma'i sems sun phyung bar 'gyur/ de'i bka' las 'das na nges par gnyis par 'gyur la de bzhin spun la khro ba gsum pa'o// byams pa btang ba bzhi par 'gyur la slar yang lnga pa byang chub sems ni rab tu nyams pa'o// drug pa grub mthar smod dang bdun pa yang ni yongs su ma smin mi la gsang ba sbyin pa la// phung po rnams la sdang ba brgyad pa yin la dgu pa gang zhig dag pa'i chos mi ni 'dod pa// rgyu can rnams la byams pa bcu pa ming sogs bral zhing bde ba ster la brtags pa bcu gcig pa// dag pa'i sems can rnams la skyon brjod bcu gnyis pa ste dam tshig rnyed pa spong ba bcu gsum pa// bud med rnams la smod pa nges par bcu bzhi par 'gyur rdo rje theg par gnas pa rnams kyi'o// zhes pas ltung ba rnams kyis ma gos par bya'o// gal te gos par gyur kyang*/ dbang bskur bdun gyis gnas pa'i yon tan can gyi rtsa ba'i ltung ba rnams ni rnam par dag par 'gyur/ zhes 'byung bas gsos te mthar phyin par bya'o// de ltar thob pa'i dus kyang nges par bya ste/ khyed rnams dbang thob pa'i lo che ge mo'o// zla ba dang zhag dang gza' skar dang sbyor ba dag byed pa dang*/ sham̐ bha lar rgyal po che ge mo chos ston pa'i tshe thob ste/ 'dir tshogs kyi nang du slob dpon gyi gnas shes par bya ba'i phyir yin no// zhes bshad do// dbang bdun gyi cho ga'o// bzhi pa dbang gong ma gsum ni/ dang por chu yis kyang ni dge bsnyen nyid du 'gyur ba la bum pa yis dge tshul nyid du 'gyur// dge slong gsang ba'i dbang bskur dag gis 'gyur la gnas brtan zhes byar bstan gyur pa/

gong ma yi rgyu yis so// zhes gsungs pas/ 'dir ye shes bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan gsum ste/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ bha ga dang*/ sems kyi dkyil 'khor te/ rdul tshon ni ma yin no// zhes gsung pas/ dang po dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bu mo lo bcu ga cig nas nyi shu'i bar bcu'am/ yang na yid las skyes pa bsgom par yang rung ste/ thog mar dgod pa ni/ shar du sgrol ma/ lhor gos dkar mo/ nub tu spyan ma/ byang du ma ma ki/ mer reg rdo rje/ bden bral ro rdo rje/ rlung du dri rdo rje/ dbang ldan gzugs rdo rje ste brgyad dang*/ mtshan ma ma nyams pa gnyis ni dbus rdo rje dbyings ma dang sna tshogs ma ste rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lo gcer bu skra grol ba lag na gri gug dang thod pa can no// 'dir dge slong dang dge tshul dang dge bsnyen rnams la drang ba dang nges pa'i dbang so so'i rigs de dang lhan cig dbang sbyin te/ yongs su smin pa ma gtogs par mngon sum pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor lor dbang mi sbyin te/ ma dad pa dang gang ma sbyangs pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims nyams shing nyes par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// gang mchog gi skyes bu ni phyag rgya mngon sum pas kyang sdom pa'i tshul khrims nyams pa med de/ rmi lam ltar bstan pa'i don shes pas so// gal te rmi lam ltar shes kyang nyams par 'gyur zhe na/ 'dul bar gang dge slong gis sngar brten pa'i bag chags las bud med dang lhan cig pa rmis shing thig le yang lhungs bas na sad pa'i tshe rmi lam du rtogs pas nyams pa med do// zhes bshad de de'i phyir rgyud 'dir dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes gsungs pas 'di khas blang dgos par gsungs mod kyi/ 'dir spros pa bzhag go /skabs su bab pa brjod de/ de ltar phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bkod nas byang phyogs su nam phyed kyi dus su maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab po/

dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal// bsgrib pa kun las 'joms byed pa// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bas khengs// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal lo// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems gang mi g.yo ba// mgon po de nas dbang bskur gyi// bka' drin de ring nyid du mdzod// bu dang bu mo sogs bcas par// bdag ni rtag tu khyod kyi bran// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// bdag gi skyabs ni gzhan med do// zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab nas/ bla mas chos dbyings rdo rje ma rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa'am/ rang gi rigs kyi phyag rgya'i nu ma la reg pa'i dbang sbyin te/ stod 'grel du nges don ni/ bum pa'i sgras phyag rgya'i nu ma bstan te/ de la reg pas dang po'i dga' ba ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ zhes so/ rang don du de ltar shes nas dpral bar o las sku rdo rje bsgom du bcug la bum pa rnams kyis khrus bya zhing*/ dpal ldan rdo rje sku 'chang ba// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas// deng 'dir byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// rdo rje'i skur ni mdzad du gsol// zhes bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa brjod nas/ oṃ ā ī rī ū lī pan tsa dhu bhi sho dha ni swa hā zhes bum pa'i chus bskrus la sku rdo rje brtan par bya'o// de'i dam tshig brjod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kun gyis ni// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad// khams gsum dbang phyug ye shes ni// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// bdag dang gzhan don bsgrub pa'i phyir// de bas gzhan na yod ma yin// skyob pa kun gyi sdom pa ni// gal te bu khyod bsrung byed na// sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis rlob// sdom pa bsrung bar mi byed na// de ltar khyod ni ngu 'bod 'gro// des na bu yis sdom pa zung*// zhes bstan nas de ltar bum pa'i dbang bskur bas/

sbyang gzhi lo bcu drug gi mthar thig le rdzogs pas 'dod pas blta ba sbyangs nas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sras gzhon nu zhes/ sa mi g.yo bar lung bstan par 'gyur bas phyir mi ldog pa bum pa'i dbang zhes bstan no// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ de nas lho phyogs su slob mas maṇḍal phul gsol ba gdab ste tshig snga ma nyid dam/ yang na/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bas khengs/ ye shes gsung la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab thabs kyi gsang ba yi// dbang bskur bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas bla ma la phyag rgya de rnams phul zhing*/ bla mas kyang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas lha thams cad kyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems pad ma'i snod la gnas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga na badzra sa bha ba atma ko ྅ haṃ gis byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma'i lce la bzhag ste/ ngag tu/ 'das pa'i rdo rje sems sogs kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ba// bdag gi byang chub sems rgyun gyi// gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin// zhes brjod la mgrin par gsung rdo rje bsgom du bcug nas/ aḥdapal ldan rdo rje gsung 'chang pa/ rdo rje mi phyed gsung*/ deng bdag /rdo rje gsung*/ phyogs bcur/ rdo rje mi phyed/ deng bdag /rdo rje gsung du mdzad du gsol// zhes byin gyis brlab po/ nges pa'i don du gsang ba la rdo rje bzhag pa ni 'jig pa'i bde ba ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo zhes so// 'di ltar gsang ba'i dbang gis/ sbyang gzhi khams rnams dang*/ 'jig rten du bud med kyi lag nas 'dzin pa la sogs pa sbyangs nas gsung rdo rje dag cing gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba dge slong du 'gyur te/ 'bras bu rgyal tshab gzhon nu legs pa'i blo gros su lung ston to// 'di rnams kyi nges pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rigs ma bcu po rang rigs skyes// dbang gi dus su rab tu sbyin// thar pa 'dod pas gzung bar bya// gang gis de rigs bsrung ba'i phyir// rig pa bla ma la mi sbyin// gzhan du khyim du gnas pa la// de la dbang ni mi sbyin no// dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang bskur ba// gzhan ni rmangs rigs skyes sogs kyi// dge slong rnams dang dge tshul la// rgyal po gong ma sbyin par bya// zhes so// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes ni/

de ni dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su maṇḍal phul gsol ba gdab pa/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bas khengs// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems gang mi g.yo ba// mgon po de nas dbang bskur gyi// bka' drin de ring nyid du mdzod// shes rab ye shes dbang bskur ba// bdag la da lta nyid du stsol// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas bla mas/ sngags dang zhing dang rigs skyes kyi phyag rgya'am/ yang na sna tshogs yum bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis spros te byin nas/ sna tshogs gzugs can lha mo ni// rten byar rgyal ba rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// zhes pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi chags pa yang*// dpral ba la sogs rnams su dgod// swa ham̐ gsang ba'i gtsug gtor tu// de nas pad ma rnam sbyangs la// a yig padma 'dab ma brgyad// hūm̐ gi yi ge rdo rje ldan// de bzhin rdo rjer bcas pad mar// shes rab rgyu mthun pa yi rgyu// hūm̐ phaṭa byas la de nas ni// rnal 'byor go gu rdor 'dzin bskyod// zhes mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs shing yab yum gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba'i don rtogs par byas nas/ yang brjod pa/ bha gar ling ga bzhag nas ni// byang chub sems ni btang mi bya// khams gsum ma lus pa ru ni// sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan bsgom par bya// gal te mtshan mar chud sems kyis// byang chub sems ni zhu gyur na// phyag rgya shes nas rang lce yis// pad ma'i phyir son lce yis blang*// zhes pas dga' ba bzhi'i don nges par bya ste/ snying khar sgra can la gnas pa'i thugs rdo rjer bsgoms nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba// rdo rje mi/ deng bdag /rdo rje thugs su/ phyogs bcur/ rdo rje mi phyed/ deng bdag /rdo rje thugs su mdzad du gsol/ zhes brtan par byas nas/ 'dir nges pa'i don du dbang po gnyis kyi snyoms par 'jug pa de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo zhes gsungs so// de nas yang dam tshig sbyin pa/

de nyid ma lus bsrung byas na// tshe 'di nyid du ni sangs rgyas 'gyur// tshul khrims tshogs ni yongs rdzogs pa// bsod nams ye shes tshogs ldan pas// pha rol phyin pa bcu 'thob ste// yang dag sangs rgyas dus gsum du// thams cad 'dir ni sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar byed// de las mchog tu ye shes med// khams gsum kun gyi dbang phyug tu// stong dang snying rje dbyer med pas// rang dang gzhan don 'grub par 'gyur// zhes brjod do// dbang 'di ni sbyang gzhi 'dzag pa'i bde ba 'jig rten pa rmongs par byed pa ste// sbyong byed las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgyas sbyangs pas thugs rdo rje rnam par dag ste/ 'bras bu chos kyi sprin du lung bstan par 'gyur ba sangs rgyas gnyis pa bzhin no// des na gnas brtan zhes bya'o// de ltar dbang 'di la rgyud du rgya cher gsungs kyang 'dir cho ga tsam zhig byas kyi rnam par dbye ba ma byas so// dbang gi phyag rgya dang bum pa 'dzin pa'i bu mo yang shin du brtag dgos te/ bkrag dang sems ni rnam par 'khrul dang g.yo can gzhan gyi dbang song nad dang bcas dang btsas pa dang*// khro dang khengs dang nor la brkam dang brdzun can 'thab mo la dga' rang lus dman dang ma dag pa// 'di rnams shes rab ye shes dbang la mi yi bdag po shin tu sgrin pa'i bla mas spang bar bya// rgyan rnams thams cad spang shing btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra'i bu mo bzang mo lo grangs bcu gnyis ma// sngar gsungs sangs rgyas la gus bla ma dang ni dam tshig 'dzin pa 'dud par bya zhing mchod par bya// zhes gsungs so// lnga pa phyag rgya chen po'i dbang ni/ dpe don gnyis las/ dpe ni/ dang po gsum pa'i dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba las/ byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i dus lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bral gyi dbus su thig le gsum pa'i mthar 'dod pa'i skad cig tsam 'dir kun du bzang po'i bde ba nyid rang rig pa zhes bya ba dang*/

he badzra las kyang*/ mchog mtha' dga' bral dang por ni/ mun pa la ni mar me ltar// de bzhin bus kyang yid ches gyis/ zhes 'byung bas dga' ba bzhi'i rim pa la sku gsung thugs ye shes su dbye bas bcu drug go/ de yang sa chu me rlung gi khams kyi dbye bas rgya cher gsungs so// 'dir/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// zhes pas don gyi ye shes brjod de gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi tshig gis las kyi phyag rgya'i bde ba la kun tu bzang po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar mi 'gyur ro// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes nyams pa phyugs nyid du byed pa la sangs rgyas nyid med do// phyag rgya chen po ye shes med pas so// zhes gsungs pas 'dir phyag rgya chen po grub pa brjod do// thog mar gser la sogs pa'i maṇḍal byas la gsol ba gdab ste sngar bshad pas sam/ yang na/ sgrib pa ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid can// rdo rje sems dpa' mi 'gyur ba// phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes kyi// dbang bskur bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ 'dir bstan par bya ba/ lus gnad bcas te 'di'i don shes par gyis cig bcom ldan 'das kyis rtsa ba'i rgyud du gsungs pa/ las kyi phyag rgya yongs spangs la// ye shes phyag rgya rnam brtags dor// mchog tu mi 'gyur rnal 'byor pas// phyag rgya chen po bsgom par bya/ zhes gsungs pas ye shes lnga'i tshul rtogs par bya ste/ gsungs pa/ stong pa'i dngos po dngos 'di la// brtags pa'i gzugs ni spangs pa ste// gzhon nu ma yi me long du// gzugs brnyan bzhin du mthong ba nyid// ces bebs po ma yin pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba gzugs kyi phung po me long lta bu'i ye shes so// dngos po thams cad mnyam par 'gyur// gcig gi rang bzhin g.yo med gnas// g.yo med ye shes yang dag 'byung*// chad pa min pa rtag min pa// zhes tshor ba'i phur po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so// thams cad 'du shes bdag nyid de// a yi yi ge rigs las byung*// g.yo med chen po'i go 'phang rnyed// shes pa med cing shes bya'ang med// ces 'du shes kyi phung po so so kun du rtogs pa'i ye shes so// skye ba med pa'i chos rnams la// 'du byed spangs pa rnams la yang*// byang chub med cing sangs rgyas med// sems can srog kyang med pa'o// zhes 'du byed kyi phung po bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes so// rnam par shes pa'i chos las 'das// ye shes dag cing dri ma med// rang bzhin 'od gsal ba yi chos// chos kyi dbyings su son par son// zhes rnam par shes pa'i phung po shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so// zhes 'byung bas don 'di dbang bzhi pa ste/

des na 'di rtogs par byed pa sbyor ba'i yan lag drug ste/ de'ang*/ so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang*// srog rtsol de bzhin 'dzin pa dang*// rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin// rnal 'byor yan lag drug ces bya// de yang rgyas par/ so sor bsdud pa yul dang dbang po rnams g.yo ba med par lus gnad dang lta stangs la sogs pa la rten nas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags mngon du byed cing bsam gtan gyis mngon par shes pa lnga grub nas/ srog rtsol gyis g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba dag ste 'dzin pa dbu mar 'gog la/ rjes dran gyis byang chub kyi sems sbyangs nas ting nge 'dzin rnam par dag pas sangs rgyas nyid 'grub ste/ bsgom pa rnams la rgyas par rim pas da bzod khong du chud par bya'o// rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ du ba la sogs pa bsgom pa nyid// sems ni mi g.yo ba ru bya// dbu ma dag par byas nas ni// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba bsgom// rdo rje pad mar rab bzhag nas// srog ni thig ler rab tu gzhug /thig le 'khor lo thig le rnams// rgyu mthun rdo rje dgag pas ni// rnal 'byor de la rtag tu 'khyud// steng du sa bon rtag tu bya// phyag rgya che la rab sbyar nas// rdo rje 'bebs pas byin gyis brlabs// nyi khri cig stong drug brgya ni// mchog tu mi 'gyur skad cig la// rgyal po chen po yongs mkhyen nas// rdo rje sems dpar rang nyid 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa 'di ni dbang bzhi pa mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'o// zhes rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa bla ma'i man ngag dang gzhung bzhin brda' sprad par bya'o// dbang bzhi pa 'di lus ngag yid dang ye shes kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ nyon mongs dang shes bya dang snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa spangs pas ye shes kyi rdo rje rnam par dag pa kun du 'od tu lung bstan par 'gyur ro// dbang gong ma'o/ drug pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la gnyis te/

gang la sbyin pa dang*/ cho ga las/ dang po ni 'dir dbang thob cing rgyud mnyan pa dang bsgrub pa byas nas slob dpon du 'gyur ba la sbyin zhes pad ma can du gsungs so// 'on kyang dang por sbyin du rung ste/ de yang rab ni dge slong dang 'bring dge tshul/ tha ma dge bsnyen ni khyim pa rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes bya'o// cho ga ni 'dir dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol sa gzhi mnyam pa'i char gdan bya ste/ shing stan gru bzhi pa cig la pad ma 'dab brgyad khru do pa tshon rdzogs pa/ re ga lngas bskor ba/ dge slong la ste gzhon nu ma brgyad dang*/ ma nyams pa gnyis dang bcus dbang sbyin no// khru do pa'i gdan ri mo lnga pa dang bu mo drug gi dbu rgyan bcing ba ni dge tshul lo// khru gang pa'i shing gtan ri mo gsum par dge bsnyen te khyim pa'i slob dpon la bu mo cig gis bkru zhing rdo rje sor gdub tsam gyis bya/ zhes gsungs so// de nas maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab cing dam bca' ba ni/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dpal ldan bla ma khyod spang nas// bla ma gzhan la rmi lam du// srog dor nas kyang brten mi bya// gzhan yang de bzhin dus kun tu// g.yo sgyu med par nus tshad kyis// lus ngag sems dang gsum po ni// gtso bo'i spyan sngar 'bul bar bgyi// bla med gong ma mchog gi dbang*// de ring bdag la bstsal du gsol// gang gi bdag ni khyod drin la// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter phye bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum mo// de nas khri la bzhag ste/ bum pa'i chu bu mo'i lag tu gtad nas slob dpon gyis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis skal ba dang ldan pa 'di la/ rdo rje bdud rtsi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod la/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// de bzhin du ni lha yi chu// dag pa yis ni khrus bgyi'o// oṃ kā lā tsa kra hūm̐/ pan tsa dhu bhi sho dha ni swa hā/ a bhi shin tsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing khrus byas nas khams lnga yum lngar gyur par bsam mo// de nas yang slob dpon gyis dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs sngar ltar bu mo'i lag tu gtad la/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis rdo rje'i dbu rgyan sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid can dang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu'i cod pan bcing du gsol zhes brjod nas/ ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yis// rin chen dag pa'i dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ kā lā tsa kra hūm̐/ pan tsa ta thā ga ta pa ri shud dha ya swa hā a bhi shin tsa hūm̐/ zhes dbu rgyan bskon// oṃ kā lā tsā kra hūm̐ ho phreṃ dha sa pa ra mi ta pa ri pu ra ni swa hā/ a bhi shin tsa hūm̐ zhes dar dpyangs bcing ngo*// yang slob dpon gyis/ rnam shes ye shes kyi rang bzhin thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje dril bu stsal du gsol zhes brjod la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun du bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje sbyin no// srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid 'gal byas// rang bzhin dag mchog sems dpa' yis// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ kā lā tsakra hūm̐/ ho surya tsan tra bhi shud dha yā ka la swa hā a bha shin tsa hūm̐ zhes dril bu'o// yang rdo rje the bong byin la/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rang gi btsun mo rnam pa thams cad du 'dod pas btsal zhing khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyis tshad med pa'i ming gi dbang bstsal du gsol zhes brjod nas/

yid kyis lus ni brtan bya'i phyir/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod do// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags/ bī sha ye in tra ya sho dha ya a bhi shin hūm̐/ oṃ kā lā tsakra hūm̐ tsa tur bhra ma bhi ha ra bhi shud dha ya swa hā a bhi tsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas yang slob dpon gyis sngar bzhin pad ma rdo rje thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor bdag po'i bdag por rdo rje ye shes kyi sgo rtogs par bstsal du gsol zhes brjod nas rjes su gnang ba po ti la sogs gtad nas/ rdo rje che dang dril bu long*// rdo rje la ni rab tu gnas// de ni rdo rje slob dpon 'gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// oṃ shri kā lā tsakra dharma tsakra pra/ bar ta ka yā swa hā/ de nas phyag rgya byin nas nu ma la reg pa bum pa dang*/ de bzhin reg pa gsang ba dang*/ gnyis su med pa shes rab ye shes dang*/ phyag rgya chen po bzhi pa'i don sngar ltar shes par bya bas slob dpon du 'gyur te/ lo ni bcu gnyis lon pa yi// phyag rgya de la sbyin par bya// bum pa dang ni gsang ba dang*// shes rab ye shes bzhi la sbyin// zhes byung ngo*// de nas nga rgyal bskyed pa/ ti ṣṭi yo dhud sha bhu mi lab to badzra swa twa ma har thā pra ma kṣa ra trī lo kya bi dza ya kā lā tsakra bha ga bān e baṃ ka ra zhes brjod la me long bstan te/ ltos shig skal bzang rigs kyi bu/ me long gzugs brnyan 'di la ltos// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang rkyen las yang dag 'byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes// chos rnams de ltar shes gyis la// gzugs brnyan lta bu'i chos ston la// sems can don gyis rdo rje 'dzin// ces brjod do// de nas phyag rgya chen po'i dbang ni/

dbu rgyan/ rna brgyan/ mgul rgyan/ gdub bu/ ske rags/ tshangs skud do// dang po ni dbu rgyan mi bskyod par bskyed la/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas 'di la dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur du gsol zhes brjod nas/ oṃ haṃ bam̐ pan tsa a kṣa ra ma hā shud dzña sa bha bā ma ha badzra shi ro ma ni/ sha ri dza si sarba a ke bhra ma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ a ā dha na ri sha ra badzra an dha tsan dha badzra pa tro u dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod nas/ nyon cig skal bzang rigs kyi bu// spyi bor rus pa'i rgyan bcings la// bu khyod rnam shes phung po de// mi bskyod pa yi ngo bor gsal// zhe sdang gnas su dag pa'i brda'// me long ye shes mtshon pa'i brgyan// ces ngo sprad do// de bzhin du rna cha 'od dpag med du bskyed nas bcings la/ oṃ badzra kun dha li hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nyon cig skal bzang rigs kyi bu// rna bar rus pa'i rgyan bcings la// bu khyod 'du shes phung po de// snang ba mtha' yas ngo bor gsal// 'dod chags gnas su dag pa'i brda'// kun rtog ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan// ces so// de nas mgul rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan du bskyed nas/ oṃ badzra kan dhe ka ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces btags la/ nyon cig skal bzang rigs kyi bu// mgul par rus pa'i rgyan bcings la/ bu khyod tshor ba'i phur po ste// rin chen 'byung ldan ngo bor gsal// ser sna gnas su dag pa'i brda'// mnyam nyid ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan// ces so// yang gdub bskor rnam snang du bskyed la/ oṃ badzra ru tsa ko'u hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces lag gdub bcing*/ oṃ badzra mu su re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces rkang gdub bcing la/ nyon cig skal bzangs rigs kyi bu/ yan lag rus pa'i rgyan bcings pa/ bu khyod gzugs kyi phung po ni// rnam par snang mdzad ngo bor gsal// gti mug gnas su dag pa'i brda'// chos dbyings ye shes mtshon pa'i brgyan// ces so// ske rags don yod grub par bskyed de/

oṃ badzra ma kha la badzra theg gi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces bcings la/ nyon cig skal bzang rigs kyi bu// sked par rus pa'i rgyan bcings pas// bu khyod 'du byed phung po ste// don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gsal// phrag dog gnas su dag pa'i brda'// bya grub ye shes mtshon pa'i brgyan// ces so// tshangs skud rdo rje 'chang du bskyed de/ oṃ badzra ya dzño pa ni tra kān dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ces bcings la/ nyon cig skal bzang rigs kyi bu// se ral rus pa'i brgyan bcings pa/ bu khyod ye shes phung po de// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bor gsal// nga rgyal gnas su dag pa'i brda'// gnyis med ye shes mtshon pa'i rgyan// ces ngo sprad do/ de ltar bum pa sku rdo rje tshangs pa// cod pan gsung rdo rje dbang phyug /rdo rje the bong thugs rdo rje khyab 'jug /tshangs skud ye shes rdo rje zhi ba sangs rgyas te// sku bzhi'i yon tan rdzogs pa// rdo rje slob dpon du 'grel par mtshan brjod kyi lung dang sbyar nas mang du gsungs pas cho ga bsdus pa byed na/ khrus dang cod pan dang*/ rdo rje sor gdub dang*/ tshangs skud byin la rjes gnang bya'o// 'dir ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang brjod pa yin no// de nas chos bshad cing dam tshig bstan pa/ nyon cig skal ldan rigs kyi bu// chos rnams smig rgyu lta bu ste// smig rgyu la yang rang bzhin med// bus yis de ltar shes gyis la// nam mkha'i khams kyi sems can la// smig rgyu lta bu'i 'khor lo bskor// de bzhin du 'ja' tshon dang*/ chu zla dang*/ sgyu ma dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ mig yor dang*/ dri za'i grong khyer dang*/ gzugs brnyan dang*/ brag cha dang*/ nam mkha' dang*/ sprul pa ste thams cad gong ma bzhin bshad do// nyon cig skal bzang rdo rje 'dzin// mngon par dbang ni de lta bur// thob nas las 'di mi bya ste// dge slong dag gam dge tshul lam// yang na slob dpon khyim pa yis// ral gri dang ni snag tsha dang*// zhing dang khyim gyi las dang ni// tshong la sogs pa mi bya'o// byas na chos ni phyin ci log

/mnar med par ni 'gro bar 'gyur// dam tshig de dag bsrung byed na// nges par skye ba'i 'di nyid du// phyag rgya chen po 'grub par 'gyur// de na rang gis rang la ni// yon tan dang ni skyon shes nas// bla med byang chub thob bya'i phyir// sngags kyi theg par gzhug par bya// rgyu de bas na rnal 'byor pas// mngon par dbang ni thob ma thag /'jig rten bya ba bor nas ni// gnyis med ye shes bsgom par bya// stong pa nyid las ma gtogs pa// rtog med nyid du mi 'gyur bas// des na sngon du stong pa nyid// rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgom// des na sna tshogs gzugs mthong nas// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde bsgrub phyir// las kyi phyag rgya la sogs rten// de bzhin du ni dus kun du// tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la// ye shes bsgrub par mi nus na// tshogs 'khor mchod pa la sogs bya// zhes bstan nas phan yon bshad pa// da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'gyur// sngags dang rgyud kyang 'dzin pa khyod// sangs rgyas rnams dang byang chub sems// lha rnams kun kyang mnyes par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse ba yi// chog bzhin dkyil 'khor khyod nyid kyis// shin tu brtson pas bri bar bya// sgrub pos rgyud la zhugs nas ni// gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mchog tu lta zhing zhugs pa yis// de ring khyod kyi sdig pa rnams// ma lus grol nas yang dag gnas// gzhan yang khyod la 'pho ba med// bde chen theg pa 'di nyid la// 'khor ba shin du dag byas nas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams las log /tshe ldan de ring dbang nyid kyis// sangs rgyas kun dang rdo rjer bcas// khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid kyis/ rje bor khyod nyid nges pa'o// 'dod chags bral ba'i sdig lta bu// khams gsum na ni yod ma yin// de phyir 'dod chags dang bral ba// khyod kyis nam yang bya ba yin// chags pa kun la nges par spyod// bde la gnas ni 'jigs pa med// sha lnga bdud rtsi dang bcas spyod// dam tshigs gzhan yang de bzhin bsrungs// srog gcod pa ni nam yang min// dpal gyi rin chen spang mi bya// sdom pa spang bar mi bya zhing*// khyod kyis slob dpon mi spang ngo*// de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa la// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// shes rab thabs kyi chos ldan pas// khyod la sdig med 'jigs mi dgos// zhes brjod do// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'o// da ni rjes kyi bya ba la gsum/

mchod pa dang*/ yon 'bul ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol ba'o// dang po ni/ gzhon nu ma rnams nyin mor dngar ba'i zas la sogs pa byin nas gshegs su gsol lo// de nas dbyug gu bdun pa la dge slong gi dge 'dun la/ nya dang shwa med pa'i dngar ba'i bza' ba la sogs pas tshim par byas la yon phul te/ lha khang du bzhugs so// de nas bug pa med pa'i dben par tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya'o// cho ga 'dir ma bstan pas gzhan du bshad do// de nas yon 'bul ba rgyud las/ lag pa rkang pa lus po rnams ni cha drug nang na kyang ni yan lag mchog ni sbyin par bya// las kyi dbang po rnams las ngag ste yon tan bcas pa'i yid ni dbang po rnams kyi nang nas so// khams rnams nang nas khams kyi cha ste rkang gnyis phyugs kyi tshogs dang gzhan yang de nyid cha shas rnams// slob dpon la ni phul na phyag rgya bzang mo rjes su reg cing bde ba'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar dbul lo// gzhan yang*/ dbang bskur mthar ni dpal ldan bum pa rnams la gos zung 'jam po lus la bde ster zung cig ni// sbyin bya dpal ldan rnal 'byor ma rnams la ni gzhan yang de bzhin du gos bu zung cig dag gis so// sgo bsrungs la yang sbyin zhing 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus gzhan la de bzhin bdag gis nus pa yis// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba ni/ mthar ni sbyin bsreg byas te rang gi snying kha'i pad mar ye shes sems dpa' rab tu gzhug par bya// 'jig rten pa rnams nges par rang gi gnas su yang ste rdul tshon ma lus chu klung gtsang mar bskyal// zhes bshad pas/ zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg byas nas mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar ye shes pa rang gi lus la bsdu zhing*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ tshangs sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// gang dag cho ga'i bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul par gang gyur dang*// ma tshang pa dang lhag ma rnams// kun du bzod par mdzad nas kyang*// rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol// slar yang sems can don slad du// de nyid du ni byon par mdzod// zhes brjod la/

rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas khor yug nas dbus kyi bar tshangs thig gi rgyud du phyin nas/ rang gi spyi bor rdul tshon cung zhig blangs te/ ma lus par bsdu bar bya'o// gang mchod par byed pa la nyes pa med do// gzhan lhag ma med par bsdus la/ rin po che'i bum par blugs nas/ glang po che'am khyogs kyi khri la khyer la/ mchod pa'i bye brag du ma dang bcas pas/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo'i ngogs su khyer la/ der yang pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la klu chen po brgyad bsams nas/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas nas/ rdul tshon khyer bar mos te/ chu bor dor ro// slar bum pa de chus bkang la dkyil 'khor gyi khang par 'ongs nas bkra shis dang smon lam bya'o// rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba'i rim pa'o// 'dir longs spyod med pa'i skyes bu dam pa lam la 'jug pa rnams la ni rgyud las/ longs spyod med pa'i a ba dhu ti pa ni dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bdag po'i tshig gis sbyin par bya// de bzhin du ba la sogs lam dang ma lus yon tan 'byung gnas rtsa ba'i sbyor bar bcas pa dang*// brten pa'i don du lag pa'i phyag rgya rang gi sems kyi dbang du son pa kun snyoms rnam par grol// gzhan du ma mo'i mchod pa dman la rgyal ba mchog gi snying po nyid ni sbyin par bya ba min// zhes ḍas 'grel pa dpang por bya'o// de ltar dbang bskur ba'i phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug sel cing mthar thug phyag rgya chen po 'grub ste/ rdo rje 'chang nyid thob po// dpal dus kyi 'khor lor dbang bskur bas rgyud thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// rgya cher rgyud 'grel du rtogs par bya'o// dpal ldan shākya seng ges rgyal sras rnams la bka' bstsal nas// lha dang lha min mi rnams snga med mchog tu dbang bskur la/ rgyal ba'i dbang por lung bstan rgyal sras zla ba bzang po yis// sham bha la zhes rab grags thub pa'i gnas mchog ka la par// snang mdzad drug brgya'i lo la shes rab dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kyis// nyi ma'i shing rta la sogs brtul nas nyung ngu'i rgyud bstan te// spyan ras gzigs dbang rgya cher 'grel mdzad rim par gang byung ba// mkhas grub rnams kyis bshad ltar dkyil 'khor dbang
